name: Columba
introduction: is the Dove, introduced by Petrus Plancius in 1592, perhaps representing Noah’s dove. It lies south of Lepus.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: Mu Columbae is a runaway star ejected from the Orion Nebula region about 2.5 million years ago, along with AE Aurigae; the two are moving apart in opposite directions.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Phact](hip:26634), Alpha Columbae, is a blue-white star surrounded by gas. [Wazn](hip:27628) is an orange giant.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: Columba contains the globular cluster NGC 1851.
